<ab>N.</ab> of a hump-backed nurse or slave of Kaikeyī who instigated
 her mistress, on the eve of Rāmaʼs coronation as heir-apparent, to beg
 of her husband by the two boons formerly promised to her by him, the banishment
 of Rāma for fourteen years and the installation of Bharata on the throne;
 {#manTarAM praviSasvAdO kEkeyIM ca tataH param#} <ls>A. Rām.</ls>

slow in judgment, void of discrimination; {#unmaTya#}
 {#manTaravivekamakARqa eva#} <ls>Māl. 1. 18</ls>.
